source_text: Denique Abeli filio parentum peccatum nihil nocuisse sanctitas eius Scripturis omnibus celebrata testatur.
pass_a_gloss: Finally that the parents' sin harmed Abel the son in nothing, his holiness celebrated by all the Scriptures testifies.

lemmas.lexica: LS peccatum=fault, error; Blaise Christian sin
LS filius; Blaise Son of God

pass_b_english: Finally, the holiness of their son Abel, celebrated throughout Scripture, testifies that his parents’ sin did him no harm (Genesis 4:4; Matthew 23:35; Hebrews 11:4; 1 John 3:12).

choices.why: Parents insofar as parents are not guilty; keep the forensic 'in quantum parentes sunt'.
Julian's forensic/moral fault tied to will, not a substance in nature.

anf_compare.notes: Victorian English of some of Julian survives inside NPNF Augustine (chiefly On Marriage and Concupiscence and related anti-Pelagian books). NPNF was not copied. Pass A is a literal gloss of Augustinus.it Latin of Julian's words only; Augustine's replies in the same locus are excluded.

bible_refs.note: From Pass B Scripture tagging; wording follows Julian's Latin, not a modern Bible.

speaker: Julian of Eclanum (words preserved in Augustine, Opus imperfectum contra Iulianum); Augustine's reply at this locus is excluded.
